home.badge: Food crops · Côte d'Ivoire and worldwide
home.titleLead: We find buyers for your food crops
home.lead: We negotiate the deals for you: we find the buyers, negotiate the price and follow the sale through to delivery. Buying food crops? We find the suppliers too.
home.service1Text: We identify the suppliers able to meet your need.
home.service2Text: We consult, compare and negotiate offers on your behalf.
home.service3Text: One clear proposal, one point of contact, one traceable payment.
home.service4Text: We coordinate preparation and delivery until the goods are received.
home.step1Text: Product, quantity, delivery location, deadline and packaging.
home.step2Text: SOON TRADE solicits and compares offers. You have no one to chase.
home.step3Text: Prices, quantities, lead times and terms. You accept, decline or ask for a change.
home.step4Text: Payment, preparation and delivery are tracked in your space.

solicitations.title: Solicitations and offers
solicitations.supplierIntro: Price requests sent to you by SOON TRADE. Reply before the deadline.
